title: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake kills at least 47 in Indonesia
content: A search and rescue operation is under way to find survivors in Flores, an island in eastern Indonesia.

title: Morocco detains dozens of migrants trying to cross into Ceuta, reports say
content: Security had been stepped up amid suggestions on social media of a second mass crossing on Saturday.

title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
content: Israel's military said it had struck "Hezbollah terror infrastructure" in response to what it described as earlier action against its soldiers.

title: Qatar denies it is detaining three Iranian bomber pilots
content: Iran says Qatar is holding three pilots who were shot down in March. Doha decries 'misleading statements'.

title: California tackles multiple wildfires as firefighter workforce faces strain
content: The federal wildland firefighting workforce, faced with low pay and cost of living issues, copes with Trump-era cuts.

title: Canadian petition to expel US ambassador gains over 170,000 signatures
content: The petition is set to be discussed by House of Commons in a sign of discontent with policies of US President Trump.
